text: Fee schedule update effective Q3: transaction fees for equity products reduced by 2 basis points.
Symbol migration notice: legacy ticker ABCX will be retired and replaced by ABCX.N on the new venue segment.
Scheduled maintenance window this weekend, trading systems unavailable for four hours starting 02:00 UTC.
Protocol update: FIX gateway will require TLS 1.3 for all new sessions starting next month.
Member firm hotline update: support contact number for connectivity issues has changed.
New market data feed available covering after-hours trading activity for listed derivatives.
Clearing house circular: margin requirements for index futures will increase ahead of quarterly expiry.
Corporate action notice: upcoming stock split for a widely held index constituent.
Connectivity bulletin: cross-connect provider migrating to a new data center, expect brief interruption.
Regulatory filing deadline reminder for participants subject to transaction reporting obligations.
Notice withdrawn and superseded by a later circular, this document should not be actioned.
New order type introduced for the continuous trading session, available from next trading day.
Holiday trading calendar update for the upcoming public holiday in the venue's home jurisdiction.
API versioning notice: the current REST API version will be deprecated in six months.
Risk control update: new price collar thresholds for volatile trading sessions.
Settlement cycle change: move from T+2 to T+1 for eligible securities, effective next quarter.
Document corrupted in transit, original circular could not be recovered from the source system.
New reference data field added to the instrument reference file for options contracts.
Vendor advisory: third-party market data terminal will undergo a scheduled software upgrade.
Exchange group announcement: consolidation of two trading segments into a single order book.
